select ACID ACID2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_RENEWALOPTIONTABLE WHERE ACID='PA5465951'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_RENEWALOPTIONTABLE WHERE ACID='PA10027851'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_RENEWALOPTIONTABLE WHERE ACID='PA1179545'
UNION ALL
SELECT ACID ACID2, * FROM
EDS.DEP_RENEWALOPTIONTABLE WHERE ACID='9999' ) temp order by ACID, SCD_START_DATE
